title: Broadfoot and Broadfoot
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: A world renowned sculpture park has been created in Wayne, New Jersey. Scott A. Broadfoot was asked to put together this multi-year fundraiser. All works are available for sale with a portion of the sale going to Laurelwood Arboretum. We invite you to take a stroll through this 30 acre park and see how nature and sculpture compliment each other.
